cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — standing close to a high shelf or line; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the upper gallery of a Han-era house — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a shopping mall atrium with a fountain and glass railings — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a fashion runway under white spotlights — holds her keepsake at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — holds a small bouquet at chest height
